summary: OpenCode made DeepSeek V4.1 Flash free on 2026-10-15 and updated it to DeepSeek's 1017 release on 2026-10-19, keeping the same model ID. OpenCode's Console docs list DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free (deepseek-v4.1-flash-free) with free input, output and cached reads for a limited time. The free tier works only inside the OpenCode app: a keyless direct API call on 2026-10-19 was rejected with "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode," although the Inference API docs still say free chat models can be called without an Authorization header. No in-app request was tested, and whether the app needs an account is unconfirmed. No end date is stated. Per OpenCode's docs, its provider follows a zero-retention policy and does not use your data for model training. The paid DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (deepseek-v4.1-flash, $0.30/$1.20 per 1M input/output tokens) and its OpenCode Go plan listing are separate, so pick the Free variant.
claim_steps: Install the OpenCode app from https://opencode.ai.

Run /models and select DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free (opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free), not the paid DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Existing setups pick up the 1017 update automatically; OpenCode says no changes are needed.
Direct API calls to the free model from outside OpenCode are rejected (HTTP 403 FreeTierError, tested 2026-10-19), despite older wording in the Inference API docs.
Whether the in-app free tier needs an OpenCode account or billing details was not tested.
The free period is limited-time; use the exact -free model ID rather than the separately priced paid variant.
